plugins.name: gcp-devkit
plugins.description: Practical Google Cloud guidance for Terraform, Cloud Run, GKE, Firestore, IAM reviews, and incident diagnosis.

skills.name: cloud-run-deploy
skills.description: Scaffold everything needed to deploy a service to Cloud Run. Use when the user asks to deploy an app to Cloud Run, containerize for Cloud Run, or wants a production-ready service.yaml with concurrency, min and max instances, CPU limits, and a dedicated service account.
headings: Example: Node.js API on Cloud Run
skills.description_zh: 为 Cloud Run 服务部署生成所需骨架，包括容器化、生产 service.yaml、并发、最小/最大实例、CPU 限制和专用服务账户。

skills.name: firestore-rules
skills.description: Generate or audit Firestore security rules. Use when the user asks to write Firestore rules for a new collection, review an existing rules file, or find open access patterns like `allow read, write: if true` that expose every document to the public internet.
headings: Generate or audit Firestore security rules
Example: user-owned notes plus a public users directory
skills.description_zh: 生成或审计 Firestore 安全规则，用于新集合规则、既有规则检查，以及发现无条件允许读写等公开暴露模式。

skills.name: gcloud-debug
skills.description: Diagnose common GCP failures on Cloud Run, GKE, and Cloud Functions. Use when the user reports a Cloud Run cold start, 500 or 503 responses, a revision that will not serve traffic, a GKE pod in CrashLoopBackOff or ImagePullBackOff, a Cloud Functions deployment error, or a Cloud Functions runtime error. Shows the exact gcloud commands to pull logs and metrics.
headings: Cloud Run: cold start or 5xx responses
Cloud Functions: deploy or runtime error
skills.description_zh: 诊断 Cloud Run、GKE 和 Cloud Functions 常见故障，涵盖冷启动、500/503、修订不接流量、CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePullBackOff 和函数部署/运行错误，并提供读取日志指标的 gcloud 命令。

skills.name: gke-manifest
skills.description: Generate GKE-tailored Kubernetes manifests that use Workload Identity, BackendConfig, and Ingress with Google-managed certificates. Use when the user asks to deploy to GKE, set up Workload Identity for a workload, expose a service through a Google-managed certificate, or configure health checks and CDN through BackendConfig.
headings: Example: HTTP API with Workload Identity, BackendConfig, and ManagedCertificate
skills.description_zh: 生成适配 GKE 的 Kubernetes 清单，使用 Workload Identity、BackendConfig 和 Google 托管证书 Ingress，用于部署、身份接入、健康检查与 CDN 配置。

skills.name: iam-audit
skills.description: Audit IAM bindings on a GCP project for overly broad roles and stale service account keys. Use when the user asks to review IAM on a project, find who has owner or editor, find unused service account keys, or assess the least-privilege posture of a GCP project before a security review.
headings: Step 1: pull the project IAM policy
Step 6: cross-reference with Cloud Audit Logs (optional)
skills.description_zh: 审计 GCP 项目 IAM 的过宽角色与陈旧服务账户密钥，查找 owner/editor、未使用密钥并评估最小权限状态。

skills.name: terraform-gcp
skills.description: Generate idiomatic Terraform for common GCP resources. Use when the user asks to write Terraform for a Cloud Run service, a GCS bucket with lifecycle rules, a Cloud SQL instance, a Pub/Sub topic and subscription, an Artifact Registry repository, or a service account with least privilege. Produces modular HCL that fits existing project layout when present.
headings: Example: Cloud SQL Postgres with private IP
Example: service account with least privilege
skills.description_zh: 为 Cloud Run、带生命周期的 GCS、Cloud SQL、Pub/Sub、Artifact Registry 和最小权限服务账户生成模块化 Terraform HCL，适配已有项目布局。

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the local GCP toolchain. Reports gcloud version, active account, active project, default region, terraform version, and kubectl context if GKE is in use. Use before running any GCP skill to confirm the environment is ready.

commands.name: full-audit
commands.description: Run the full GCP audit pass in one command. Chains doctor, project, and iam-audit into a single report. Use as a pre-release or pre-handoff check to surface environment, project, and IAM findings in one pass.

commands.name: project
commands.description: Show the active GCP project, its lifecycle state, and the projects the current account can access. Use before any operation that changes cloud state so the user confirms they are pointing at the right project. Does not change state.

headings: Recommended: install from this GitHub marketplace
